alt: The values of nums are tested one at a time against the condition x % 2 == 0. A value that passes is added to the new list evens, shown above the cells; a value that fails is skipped. The first preset keeps two of five values; the second keeps none, leaving evens empty.

steps.caption: x is 3. 3 % 2 == 0 is False, so the condition fails and 3 is skipped.
x is 4. 4 % 2 == 0 is True, so the condition passes and 4 is added to `evens`.
x is 7. 7 % 2 == 0 is False, so the condition fails and 7 is skipped.
x is 8. 8 % 2 == 0 is True, so the condition passes and 8 is added to `evens`.
x is 9. 9 % 2 == 0 is False, so the condition fails and 9 is skipped.
Every value has been checked. `evens` is [4, 8].
x is 1. 1 % 2 == 0 is False, so the condition fails and 1 is skipped.
x is 3. 3 % 2 == 0 is False, so the condition fails and 3 is skipped.
x is 5. 5 % 2 == 0 is False, so the condition fails and 5 is skipped.
Every value has been checked. Nothing passed the condition, so `evens` is the empty list, [].
